question: Using the sales data, what is the median value of total sales made in countries where the number of customers is greater than 4?
sql:
WITH qualifying_countries AS (
    SELECT Country
    FROM customers
    GROUP BY Country
    HAVING COUNT(CustomerId) > 4
),
country_totals AS (
    SELECT i.BillingCountry, SUM(i.Total) AS total_sales
    FROM invoices i
    JOIN customers c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
    WHERE c.Country IN (SELECT Country FROM qualifying_countries)
    GROUP BY i.BillingCountry
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_sales) AS median_total_sales
FROM country_totals
